## Change Summary

- **What changed?** The default LingBot-VA RoboTwin train/eval recipe now reproduces the evaluated FP32-reduce release (RoboTwin-2.0, 50 tasks: Easy 87.6% / Hard 85.7%).
  - `features.py`: `LINGBOT_FSDP_BF16_REDUCE` defaults to off, because BF16 reduction rounds away small action-head gradients. Adds `LINGBOT_VA_FIXED_MICROBATCH_RNG`, also off by default. When it is off, each rank draws its own timesteps/noise/chunk/window like the community trainer, instead of every rank sharing the hard-coded per-microbatch RNG draw.
  - `modeling_lingbot_va.py`: the per-microbatch reseeding in `_prepare_input_dict` is now behind that switch. Turning it on gives the previous behaviour byte for byte.
  - `run_lingbot_va_robotwin_fsdp_finetune.sh`:
    - initialises from `lingbot-va-base`;
    - 50000 iters, GA 8 (8 GPUs x 1 x 8 = global batch 64);
    - `--set-seed-by-rank`, `--fsdp-unshard-param-dtype bfloat16`, `--no-fsdp-cast-forward-inputs`;
    - spells out the remaining flags of the evaluated run: `--no-batch-drop-last`, `--fsdp-min-param-num`, `--fsdp-reduce-dtype fp32`, `--manual-gc --manual-gc-interval 50`, `--detail-log-interval 20`, `--loss-log-rank=-1`;
    - artifact root is a placeholder.
  - `robotwin_runner.py`: one added line that maps `benchmark.instruction_type` from YAML.
    - Before this, `orchestrator.run` calls `build_argparser().parse_args([])`, so `--instruction-type` could never be set and every run used `unseen`.
    - Other models' YAMLs do not set the key, so they still get `unseen`.
  - LingBot-VA RoboTwin template: sets `instruction_type: seen`. The community client hard-codes `instruction_type = 'seen'` in `evaluation/robotwin/eval_polict_client_openpi.py`.
  - New `examples/embodied/lingbot_va/eval/configs/robotwin/robotwin_50tasks.yaml`: the full 50-task protocol of the released numbers, and now the default of `run_robotwin_eval.sh`. Users only fill paths.
    - seen instructions, start seed 10000, expert check on, 50 episodes per task;
    - the official per-task step limit as `max_steps`, set per task through `sweep`;
    - `task_config: demo_clean` for Easy, `demo_randomized` for Hard.

    The protocol lives in this LingBot-VA config only; the runner change is still the one mapping line. `adjust_bottle.yaml` stays as the one-episode smoke test.
  - Docs: the LingBot-VA quick start (en/zh) is rewritten in the GR00T-N1.7 layout (training preparation, post-training, evaluation preparation, evaluation) and reflects the new defaults. It adds the measured speedup (same node, data and global batch, mean of steps 15-45: RoboTwin 8.98 vs 25.55 s/step = 2.85x, LIBERO 12.49 vs 27.13 s/step = 2.17x), loss/grad-norm curves against the community trainer, the success rates and rollouts of the hardest tasks (`docs/assets/images/lingbot_va/`, every file <= 1 MB). The RoboTwin and LIBERO benchmark pages now list LingBot-VA.
  - New `examples/embodied/lingbot_va/export_eval_checkpoint.py` exports a training DCP into the checkpoint root the policy server loads. On a LIBERO 5000-step DCP, all 839 exported tensors are identical to the evaluated release.
- **Which issue or requirement does this address?** Running the shipped example with its defaults did not reproduce the released RoboTwin numbers.
- **Which modules are affected?**
  - `loongforge/embodied/model/lingbot_va/*`
  - `examples/embodied/lingbot_va/*`
  - one mapping line in `loongforge/embodied/eval/orchestrator/runners/robotwin_runner.py`

## Validation

Results with the default recipe: RoboTwin-2.0 50 tasks x 50 episodes, Easy 87.6% / Hard 85.7% (community-trained 86.1% / 85.1%); LIBERO-Long 10 tasks x 50 episodes, 84.6% (community-trained 77.8%).

## Reviewer Notes

- The recipe was validated end to end before this rebase: 50k-step training followed by the full 50-task Easy and Hard evaluation.
- No GPU smoke was run on this exact commit; the GPUs were busy.
- The evaluated run was 2 nodes x 8 GPUs x GA 4. The script default is 1 node x 8 GPUs x GA 8, which gives the same global batch of 64.

-## 2. Performance Optimization Options
-### 2.1 Baked-in Optimizations
-The following optimizations are baked into the LingBot implementation and have no toggle:
+
+Checkpoints are saved in DCP format under `$OUTPUT_DIR/checkpoints/steps_<N>`; to resume after an interruption, rerun with the same `OUTPUT_DIR` and append `--resume`. The trailing `"$@"` of the scripts is passed through to `train.py` verbatim, so any training argument can be overridden.
+
+### 2.2 Key Parameters
+
+**Script parameters** (all can be overridden through environment variables):
+
+| Parameter | RoboTwin default | LIBERO default | Description |
+|---|:---:|:---:|---|
+| `LOONGFORGE_PATH` | repo containing the script | repo containing the script | LoongForge repository root |
+| `LOCAL_VLA_ARTIFACTS_ROOT` | `/path/to/vla_artifacts` | `/path/to/vla_artifacts` | Default root of the next three paths |
+| `CHECKPOINT_PATH` | `<root>/lingbot_va/models/lingbot-va-base` | same | Initialization weights (containing `transformer/`) |
+| `DATA_PATH` | `<root>/lingbot_va/datasets/robotwin-clean-and-aug-lerobot` | `<root>/lingbot_va/datasets/libero-long-lerobot` | Dataset directory (containing `latents/` and `empty_emb.pt`) |
+| `OUTPUT_DIR` | `$LOONGFORGE_PATH/outputs/lingbot_va_robotwin` | `$LOONGFORGE_PATH/outputs/lingbot_va_libero` | Output directory |
+| `GPUS_PER_NODE` / `NNODES` | 8 / 1 | 8 / 1 | GPUs per node / number of nodes |
+| `TRAIN_ITERS` | 50000 | 5000 | Total training steps |
+| `GRADIENT_ACCUMULATION_STEPS` | 8 | 10 | Gradient accumulation steps; keep the global batch fixed when changing the GPU count (e.g. 4 and 5 on 16 GPUs) |
+| `SAVE_INTERVAL` | 0 | 0 | Checkpoint interval; 0 saves only at the end |
+| `SEED` | 42 | 42 | Global seed; with `--set-seed-by-rank` every rank uses its own seed |
+
+**Switches that affect training numerics** (exported at their recommended values by the example scripts):
+
+| Switch | Default | Description |
+|---|:---:|---|
+| `LINGBOT_FSDP_BF16_REDUCE` | `0` | `0` reduces gradients in FP32; `1` reduces in the parameter dtype (BF16), removing one FP32 reduce-scatter per step. Overrides `--fsdp-reduce-dtype`. The action branch's gradients are far smaller than the video branch's; on RoboTwin, BF16 reduction raises the action loss by about 6% and lowers the success rate, so FP32 is the default |
+| `LINGBOT_VA_FIXED_MICROBATCH_RNG` | `0` | `0` draws from the process-global streams like the community trainer, and with `--set-seed-by-rank` each rank samples its own timesteps / noise / chunk / window; `1` reseeds before every microbatch so all ranks share one draw (for step-by-step comparison with a patched community trainer) |
+| `LINGBOT_BALANCED_SAMPLER` | `1` | Deterministically balance load across DP ranks by per-sample compute cost, reducing slow-rank stragglers; it changes the sample loading order, so set `0` for step-by-step loss alignment with the community trainer (falls back to the public `DistributedSampler` partitioning) |

+# Copyright 2026 The LoongForge Authors.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""Export a LingBot-VA training checkpoint into an evaluation checkpoint root.
+
+Training saves DCP shards (``$OUTPUT_DIR/checkpoints/steps_<N>``); the LingBot-VA
+policy server loads one root holding ``transformer/`` (sharded safetensors with an
+index) plus the frozen ``vae/``, ``text_encoder/`` and ``tokenizer/``. This script
+consolidates the model tensors, strips the training wrapper prefix, writes the
+shards, index and the transformer ``config.json`` of the checkpoint the run started
+from (switched to ``attn_mode=torch``), and links the frozen components from an
+official LingBot-VA checkpoint.
+
+Usage:
+    python examples/embodied/lingbot_va/export_eval_checkpoint.py \\
+        --ckpt   /path/to/outputs/lingbot_va_robotwin/checkpoints/steps_50000 \\
+        --base   /path/to/lingbot-va-base \\
+        --codec  /path/to/lingbot-va-posttrain-robotwin \\
+        --out    /path/to/eval_ckpt/lingbot_va_robotwin_steps_50000
+
+Use ``lingbot-va-posttrain-libero-long`` as ``--codec`` for LIBERO checkpoints.
+Tensor dtypes are kept (FP32 master weights); the server casts to BF16 when
+``server.use_bf16`` is true.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from safetensors.torch import save_file
+
+REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+FROZEN_COMPONENTS = ("vae", "text_encoder", "tokenizer")
+
+
+def _load_dcp_model_tensors(ckpt: str) -> dict:
+    """Consolidate the ``model.*`` tensors with the repo's single-process DCP reader."""
+    path = REPO_ROOT / "tools" / "torch_dcp_convert" / "dcp_to_safetensors.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("dcp_to_safetensors", path)
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module._load_full_state_dict(module._resolve_dcp_dir(ckpt))
+
+
+def _parse_size(value: str) -> int:
+    units = {"gib": 1024**3, "mib": 1024**2, "gb": 1000**3, "mb": 1000**2}
+    value = value.strip().lower()
+    for suffix, scale in units.items():
+        if value.endswith(suffix):
+            return int(float(value[: -len(suffix)]) * scale)
+    return int(value)
+
+
+def _inference_tensors(state_dict: dict) -> dict:
+    """Map training state-dict keys onto the transformer's own parameter names."""
+    tensors = {}
+    for name, tensor in state_dict.items():
+        # TE modules carry empty ``_extra_state`` entries that inference does not load.
+        if name.endswith("._extra_state"):
+            continue
+        # The trainer wraps the transformer as ``LingBotVAEmbodiedModel.model``.
+        key = name[len("model."):] if name.startswith("model.") else name
+        if key in tensors:
+            raise ValueError(f"duplicate tensor name after prefix stripping: {key}")
+        tensors[key] = tensor.detach().cpu().contiguous()
+    return tensors
+
+
+def _write_transformer(tensors: dict, out_dir: Path, max_shard_bytes: int) -> int:
+    shards, current, current_bytes = [], {}, 0
+    for name in sorted(tensors):
+        size = tensors[name].numel() * tensors[name].element_size()
+        if current and current_bytes + size > max_shard_bytes:
+            shards.append(current)
+            current, current_bytes = {}, 0
+        current[name] = tensors[name]
+        current_bytes += size
+    if current:
+        shards.append(current)
+
+    weight_map, total = {}, 0
+    for number, shard in enumerate(shards, start=1):
+        filename = f"diffusion_pytorch_model-{number:05d}-of-{len(shards):05d}.safetensors"
+        save_file(shard, str(out_dir / filename), metadata={"format": "pt"})
+        for name, tensor in shard.items():
+            weight_map[name] = filename
+            total += tensor.numel() * tensor.element_size()
+    index = {"metadata": {"total_size": total}, "weight_map": weight_map}
+    (out_dir / "diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors.index.json").write_text(
+        json.dumps(index, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
+    )
+    return len(shards)
+
+
+def main(argv=None) -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
+    parser.add_argument("--ckpt", required=True, help="Training checkpoint: a steps_N directory or its dcp/.")
+    parser.add_argument("--base", required=True,
+                        help="Checkpoint the run was initialized from (its transformer/config.json "
+                             "describes the trained architecture), e.g. lingbot-va-base.")
+    parser.add_argument("--codec", required=True,
+                        help="Official LingBot-VA checkpoint providing vae/, text_encoder/ and tokenizer/.")
+    parser.add_argument("--out", required=True, help="Evaluation checkpoint root to create.")
+    parser.add_argument("--max-shard-size", default="4GiB")
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+
+    base, codec, out = Path(args.base), Path(args.codec), Path(args.out)
+    if not (base / "transformer" / "config.json").is_file():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{base} has no transformer/config.json")
+    missing = [p for p in FROZEN_COMPONENTS if not (codec / p).exists()]
+    if missing:
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{codec} is missing {missing}")
+    transformer_dir = out / "transformer"
+    if transformer_dir.exists() and any(transformer_dir.iterdir()):
+        raise FileExistsError(f"{transformer_dir} is not empty")
+    transformer_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+    tensors = _inference_tensors(_load_dcp_model_tensors(args.ckpt))
+    shard_count = _write_transformer(tensors, transformer_dir, _parse_size(args.max_shard_size))
+
+    # Training runs FlexAttention; the policy server runs the torch attention path.
+    config = json.loads((base / "transformer" / "config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    config["attn_mode"] = "torch"
+    (transformer_dir / "config.json").write_text(json.dumps(config, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    for name in FROZEN_COMPONENTS:
+        link = out / name
+        if not link.exists():
+            os.symlink((codec / name).resolve(), link)
+    print(f"[export_eval_checkpoint] {len(tensors)} tensors in {shard_count} shards -> {out}")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())
